steps.en: Clone the repo, then symlink each skill as a direct child of the skills dir
steps.zh: Clone 仓库，把技能目录软链进 ~/.claude/skills/

steps.en: Shape the idea with Claude before any build
steps.zh: 动手前先用 Claude 塑形想法

steps.en: Iterates the problem and the solution together, kept separate from implementation
steps.zh: 问题与方案一起迭代，并与实现分开

steps.en: Ask for the shaped result to be distilled
steps.zh: 要求把塑形结果蒸馏成文档

steps.en: Formats the conversation into a framing document a builder can act on
steps.zh: 把对话整理成 builder 能照做的框定文档

value.en: A framing doc the team can run with — before any code is written
value.zh: 写码之前，先有一份团队能照着干的框定文档

sources: README.md main @ archived (fetched 2026-09-28): Install — git clone https://github.com/rjs/shaping-skills.git ~/.local/share/shaping-skills; ln -s ~/.local/share/shaping-skills/framing-doc ~/.claude/skills/framing-doc; 'Each skill must be a direct child of ~/.claude/skills/'
README Skills section — /shaping iterate problem and solution before committing to implementation; /framing-doc turns conversation transcripts into a framing document
README Hook: Ripple Check — PostToolUse in ~/.claude/settings.json runs shaping-ripple.sh on files with shaping: true frontmatter
